llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a public news/search API and its requirements (curl only, no credentials, no install) match the described purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description advertise an AI-driven news/search API; SKILL.md shows only HTTP curl calls to agenttimes.live endpoints. Requiring curl and nothing else is proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to making GET requests to the service endpoints and parsing responses — they don't instruct reading files, environment variables, or other system state. One minor note: the docs mention paid access via 'x402 micropayments on Base' but the skill does not declare any payment or wallet environment variables or steps; payment handling is external to the skill and not documented here.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — lowest-risk instruction-only skill that relies on an existing curl binary.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables or credentials. That matches the public-API usage examples. The mention of paid endpoints could involve an external wallet/payment flow, but the skill does not request any payment secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no install actions; the skill does not request persistent presence or elevated privileges and does not modify other skills or configs.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only wrapper around a public news/search API and appears internally consistent. Before installing: (1) verify the homepage/documentation (https://agenttimes.live) if you need to confirm service legitimacy; (2) do not provide private keys or wallet secrets — paid endpoints mention micropayments on Base but the skill does not require or manage any wallet credentials; (3) expect the agent to make outbound network requests (the skill returns external URLs), so treat fetched links and content like any web result; (4) if you plan to enable autonomous agent invocation, be aware it could call the paid endpoints which may trigger external payment flows outside the skill — confirm how payments are handled before enabling those actions.
